title: Payload of each canonical event type, schema version 1
description: Amounts and quantities are decimal numbers or decimal strings. A field not listed is kept and ignored. Enforced at ingest: kitchen.stage.stage, cash_drawer.opened, the vision.* observations (LP1, LP2, LP5, LP7), the measurement events (LP3) and stock.movement (LP5). Otherwise a rule skips an event that lacks a field it needs.

tillId.description: The till (a CashRegister id in this ERP). The cashier vision rules match POS events to the cameras of a till with it; an event without it takes the till of its cash session, else its deviceId.

observation.description: Fields every vision.* payload carries. The envelope of an observation has evidenceLevel zone, evidenceSource camera or sensor, the zone id as deviceId and a confidence.

cameraId.description: Must be the camera of the zone named by deviceId.

clipId.description: The clip the agent kept for this observation, registered with POST /agents/clips.

tableId.description: The dining table of the order, if any. Read by the table-turnover metric (LP6a).

discountTotal.description: All discount given on the sale. Read by C07.

ingredients.description: What the line drew through its recipe, from the snapshot taken at the sale (LP3). quantity is in the product's base unit. Read by B04 and V-B1; a line without this key leaves B04 off for the day.

quantity.description: Quantity voided so far on this line. Send lineId; the largest quantity per line counts.

firedQuantity.description: Quantity already sent to the kitchen. Above 0 raises C01.

amount.description: Voided quantity × unit price; the exposure of C01.

firedLines.description: Lines already sent to the kitchen. Not empty raises C02.

originalActorId.description: Who made the sale being refunded.

override.approved.description: actorId is the cashier the override was given to.

cash_session.closed.description: Send sessionId. A session closed again is a new event; the latest occurredAt counts.

itemCount.description: Quantities on the ticket not cancelled (LP4). Read by V-K1; a period with a ticket without it is skipped.

tableId.description: The order's POS table (LP6b): the wait from a seating to the first order. Tickets projected before LP6b carry none.

itemCount.description: As on kitchen.ticket_created, when the stage was read (LP4).

afterReady.description: The ticket had been marked ready. With remade or cancelled it raises C10.

stock_count.line.description: Send lineId. A line sent again replaces the earlier copy.

varianceMl.description: counted − system. Negative is a shortage.

reasonCode.description: Null, unexplained or unrecorded_sale leaves the variance unexplained (B01).

toleranceMl.description: The product's own tolerance; else the rule's.

ledgerNetMl.description: Net stock movement since the previous count. B03 checks opening + net = system.

soldMl.description: Drawn by sales through their recipes, as recorded at each sale.

cash_drawer.opened.description: evidenceLevel session. A POS that records drawer openings sends one per opening; no_sale feeds C11 and every reason explains a V-C1 opening.

vision.dwell.description: Sent when a presence in the zone ends; endedAt is not before startedAt.

vision.state_changed.description: A drawer opening is object cash_drawer, to open; it feeds V-C1.

vision.handling.description: On a scan_area zone (LP5), action bypassed: an item carried from the input side to the bagging side without passing over the scanner; it feeds V-R2.

vision.gap.description: The camera had no usable picture from..to. observationStatus must be unavailable. No vision rule finds anything inside a gap.

vision.activity.description: LP7, research in shadow mode: what a recognizer reports about objects in a zone whose params.activityResearch is true. No rule reads it.

stock.movement.description: LP5: a stock ledger line at one location, projected from InventoryLedger for the locations linked to a storage zone. evidenceLevel item, evidenceSource stock. It explains goods leaving a store room (V-S1).

quantity.description: Above 0: a number, or a decimal string as this ERP's projection writes it.

kind.description: The ledger's movement type, e.g. transfer_out.

pour.measured.description: One pour reported by a meter (LP3). deviceId is the measurement device id; evidenceLevel item, evidenceSource sensor, observationStatus observed.

measurement.gap.description: A meter reported nothing from..to (LP3). observationStatus must be unavailable. V-B2 finds nothing inside a gap.
